Per_Request_Access_Policy (object)
Configures a Per Flow Request Access Policy
Properties (* = required):
name
type(s)
default
allowed values
description
class*
string
“Per_Request_Access_Policy”
ignoreChanges
boolean
false
true, false
If false (default), the system updates the profile in every BIG-IP AS3 declaration deployment. If true, BIG-IP AS3 creates the profile on first deployment, and leaves it untouched afterwards
label
string
“^[^x00-x1fx22#&*<>?x5b-x5d`x7f]*$”
Optional friendly name for this object. Allows 0-64 chars, excluding a few likely to cause trouble with string searching, JS, TCL, or HTML
remark
string
“^[^x00-x1fx22x5cx7f]*$”
Arbitrary (brief) text pertaining to this object. Allows 0-64 chars, excluding only control characters, double-quote, and backslash.  This is permissive enough that you should worry about XSS attacks
url*
The URL to pull the policy from,The URL for a required resource
